Information and house rules

Welcome to Finca Flamenco Holiday Suites! These house rules help ensure peace, safety and comfort for all our guests. Thank you in advance for your cooperation — we wish you a wonderful stay!

Check-in and check-out

Check-in: 14:00 – 23:00 on the day of arrival.
Check-out: before 11:00.
Arrival after 23:00 or before 11:00 must be confirmed at least 24 hours in advance by email or WhatsApp. Late check-out is possible if there's no check-in that day for the suite, for €5 per hour per suite.

Age policy

Only guests aged 18 and over may stay with us, with a valid ID or passport. Exceptions are possible for family members or friends of the owners.

Noise and quiet hours

Please respect quiet hours between 00:00 and 08:00. Commercial events or loud parties are not allowed without written permission.

Swimming pool

Closed from 1 November until mid-March.

Smoking

Allowed on the patio and at the outdoor bar. At the pool, only at the designated smoking table. Not allowed in the rooms — your own balcony is fine.

Outdoor bar

The trust bar works on a self-service basis: take your drink and honestly note what you've had. Settle up when you check out.

🍳 Outdoor kitchen, BBQ & oven

You're welcome to enjoy our outdoor kitchen, but please always arrange its use with us beforehand — preferably in the morning, as we may be away later in the day.

Before using the equipment

Please ask us to show you how the BBQ, oven and gas hob work, and where to find utensils and supplies. Do not operate this equipment without an introduction.

Dishes and utensils

There are no dishwashing facilities. Please place used dishes and cutlery in the washing-up tub by the bar. Help us keep washing-up to a minimum by using only the plates, bowls, knives and utensils you need.

The tap

The tap is only for rinsing vegetables and washing hands, not for washing dishes. The water is collected in a bucket and reused to water our plants. Thank you for helping us save water! 🌿

Own food and drinks

Not permitted on the patio, at the outdoor bar, or at the pool — please use the trust bar in these shared spaces. In your own room or on your balcony, it's of course fine.

Barbecue and open fires

Open fires or your own barbecues are not permitted. Please arrange use of our BBQ with us in advance and ask for instructions before lighting it.

Pets

Not allowed, except for certified service animals.

Visitors & photography

Overnight visitors are only allowed with prior approval. Commercial photography or filming is not permitted without written consent.

Departure

Please leave the room as you found it: take your belongings, leave no trash, wipe down tables and surfaces, wash and put away any dishes used, and leave the bathroom tidy. Return your keys at check-out — lost keys will result in the cylinders being replaced at the guest's expense.

Damage

Guests are liable for damage caused by themselves or their companions. Please report damage immediately via WhatsApp or email. Compensation is due within 7 days of departure, based on replacement value.

Breakfast

Daily: 09:00 – 10:30.
Served in the breakfast room — you're welcome to enjoy it on the patio or in your room instead.

Linens, towels & laundry

For longer stays, towels and bed linen are refreshed on request. We don't enter your room by default during your stay, to respect your privacy. Two washing machines are available in the storage room by the patio: €3.50 per cycle (40/60°C, max 7kg).

Reception

Entrance on the patio. Check in and out here, find local information, and enjoy a coffee machine for fresh coffee and tea.

WiFi & internet use

Our internet connection is provided via Starlink. Illegal downloading, streaming, file sharing, or accessing illegal websites or services through the Finca Flamenco WiFi network is strictly prohibited. Guests are responsible for their own internet activity and for any consequences arising from misuse of the network.

Complaints

Please report complaints within 24 hours by phone, followed by written confirmation by email to info@finca-flamenco.com or via the complaints form at reception.

Aircon & heating

Comfort without extremes

Cooling in summer: 22–25°C · Heating in winter: 20–23°C

Setting the temperature extremely low in summer or very high in winter does not make the room cool down or warm up faster. The unit will simply keep running while trying to reach an unnecessarily extreme temperature.

  • Please turn the aircon off when you're not in the room.
  • Keep windows and doors closed while cooling or heating.
  • Choose a comfortable temperature within the ranges above.

It saves electricity and avoids unnecessary wear on the equipment. Please use it consciously, just as you would at home. 🌿 A comfortable room is lovely — it doesn't need to be a freezer or a sauna.

Why in the bedroom?

The units are placed in the bedrooms on purpose, to keep your sleeping area comfortable. A steady, moderate setting works best — both for cooling in summer and heating in winter.

Water

In southern Spain, water is a precious resource, especially in summer during droughts. The municipality then applies water-saving measures, up to and including full shutdowns every other day or fluctuating water pressure. We keep at least 4,000 litres of water in reserve in case supply is interrupted.

This can mean reduced water pressure in your room or bathroom. Please use water mindfully: turn off the tap while brushing your teeth, shaving, or lathering up, and take shorter showers.

⚠ Illegal downloading prohibited

It is strictly prohibited to use the Finca Flamenco WiFi network to illegally download, upload or share copyrighted content such as movies, TV series, music, software, games or other media. This also applies to torrents, illegal streaming services and other unauthorized file-sharing services. Guests are responsible for their own internet activity.

No connection?

Get in touch via WhatsApp or email — see the Emergency tab for contact numbers.

TV, channels & casting Netflix

Turn on the TV with the remote control.

Make sure the Chromecast is powered on and connected to the TV. You can ignore any on-screen PIN prompt.

Connect your phone or tablet to the guest network (see the WiFi tab).

Open the app you want: Netflix, YouTube, or another app that supports casting.

Tap the cast icon (a small screen with a WiFi signal) and choose the TV named after your room.

Once connected, the content appears on screen — pause, play, or change channels from your phone or tablet.

Questions or need help? Don't hesitate to reach out — see the Emergency tab.

Playa de Los Álamos · Torremolinos

A wide and lively sandy beach more than 1.5 kilometres long, just before the busier parts of Torremolinos and La Carihuela. Along the beachfront you’ll find trendy chiringuitos, comfortable sunbeds and plenty of space for a relaxed beach day. There are watersports and parking nearby, and it is easy to reach by car from Finca Flamenco.

Open in Maps →
✦ Finca Flamenco recommends

Playa Guadalmar · Málaga

Playa Guadalmar is a quiet sandy beach in Málaga and the city's only official naturist beach. Set between a golf course and a bird-rich nature reserve, it offers a peaceful escape from the city. Despite its wild setting, there are showers, lifeguards and relaxed chiringuitos, making it a comfortable place to unwind freely in nature.
